class Metric:
    name: str
    kind: str
    direction: str
    threshold: float
    question: str
    window: str = ""


@dataclass
class Plan:
    goal: str
    questions: list = field(default_factory=list)
    metrics: list = field(default_factory=list)


def validate(plan):
    errors = []
    if not plan.goal.strip():
        errors.append("goal is required")
    qs = set(plan.questions)
    for m in plan.metrics:
        if m.kind not in ("outcome", "guardrail", "counter"):
            errors.append(f"{m.name}: unknown kind {m.kind}")
        if m.direction not in ("higher", "lower"):
            errors.append(f"{m.name}: direction must be higher or lower")
        if m.question not in qs:
            errors.append(f"{m.name}: question is not part of the plan")
        if not m.window:
            errors.append(f"{m.name}: no measurement window")
    used = {m.question for m in plan.metrics}
    for q in plan.questions:
        if q not in used:
            errors.append(f"question without a metric: {q}")
    if not any(m.kind == "outcome" for m in plan.metrics):
        errors.append("no outcome metric")
    if not any(m.kind == "guardrail" for m in plan.metrics):
        errors.append("no guardrail metric")
    return errors


def passes(m, value):
    if value is None:
        return False
    return value >= m.threshold if m.direction == "higher" else value <= m.threshold


def lock(plan):
    body = {"goal": plan.goal, "metrics": [(m.name, m.kind, m.direction, m.threshold, m.window) for m in plan.metrics]}
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"sm_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() prints a four-metric plan, validates a bad plan, tests boundary values, edits a threshold after a result and looks up three names against the plan.","descKn":"main() ನಾಲ್ಕು-ಮಾಪನ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮುದ್ರಿಸಿ, ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮಾನ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸಿ, ಅಂಚಿನ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ, ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ನಂತರ ಮಿತಿ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಯೋಜನೆಯ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಮೂರು ಹೆಸರು ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

    print("plan errors:", validate(p))

    used = {m.question for m in plan.metrics}

        errors.append("no outcome metric")
    if not any(m.kind == "guardrail" for m in plan.metrics):
        errors.append("no guardrail metric")

    kind, direction, thr = rule
    if value is None:
        return False
    return value >= thr if direction == "higher" else value <= thr


def evaluate(obs, plan=PLAN):
    res = {n: ("missing" if obs.get(n) is None else ("pass" if ok(r, obs.get(n)) else "fail")) for n, r in plan.items()}
    return res


def decide(res, plan=PLAN):
    if any(v == "missing" for v in res.values()):
        return "collect more evidence"
    if any(v == "fail" for n, v in res.items() if plan[n][0] == "guardrail"):
        return "fail (guardrail)"
    if all(v == "pass" for v in res.values()):
        return "pass"
    return "fail (outcome)""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"sm_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() evaluates three candidates, repeats the evaluation without the guardrail, handles a partial observation, tests boundary values and builds a report in memory.","descKn":"main() ಮೂರು ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡಿ, guardrail ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸಿ, ಭಾಗಶಃ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ, ಅಂಚಿನ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೆಮೊರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವರದಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. Genuinely running: three invented candidates against the fixed plan")
